title: The scarf
summary: The old man with the season ticket by the tunnel gives you his scarf, the one he's had since 1971. He says it's lucky. A season later he isn't in his seat.

ends.title: The seat by the tunnel
ends.text: He gave you his scarf. When he died, you put it on his seat.

ends.title: Just a scarf
ends.text: He gave you his scarf and you put it in a drawer. His son asked about it once.

beats.title: Since 1971

event.title: Since 1971
event.speaker: fan
setup: {fan.name} has had the seat by the tunnel since before your dad was born. After the game he leans over the rail and holds out a scarf so faded you can barely see the colours.

say: "I've had this since 1971. It's been lucky for every good player we've had. You're not one yet, but you might be. Take it."

replies.label: Take it. "I'll wear it on the bus."

say: "Don't be soft. My wife's been trying to bin it for fifty years. Take it before she wins."

took.text: It smells of cigarettes and pies. You score the next week and point at the seat by the tunnel. He stands up, which he doesn't do.

took-quiet.text: You take it and nod. He sits back down, pleased.

refused.text: "Suit yourself." He wears it himself, and gives you a nod every week anyway.

beats.hint: The old man by the tunnel wants a word

beats.title: The seat by the tunnel

event.title: The seat by the tunnel
event.speaker: fan
setup: A season on. The seat by the tunnel is empty, with a bunch of flowers on it. {fan.short} died on Tuesday. A man about your dad's age is in the next seat. He's {fan.short}'s son.

choices.label: {if arc.path=='took'}Put the scarf on his seat before kick-off.{/if}{if !arc.path=='took'}Go over and shake his son's hand.{/if}

outcomes.text: His son puts his hand on it and leaves it there for the whole first half. The stand claps in the seventy-first minute.
"He said you were all right," his son says. "From him that was a lot."
{if arc.path=='took'}The scarf is in your kit bag. You touch it before you go out, and you don't tell anyone.{/if}{if !arc.path=='took'}You look at the seat once, on the way out.{/if}

beats.hint: A season on, the seat by the tunnel
